scope: V18 Treatment best epoch validation only; requested 4 Drone->Bird, 3 Bird->Drone and 1 Balloon->Bird parents

method.model_probabilities: offline causal sequence inference from frozen Control/Treatment best checkpoints
method.feature_unit: mean stable8 current-event summaries over valid events within each parent
method.feature_scaling: train-parent-only median and IQR; validation never fits a threshold or scale
method.distance: RMS Euclidean distance in train-robust-scaled stable8 space
method.neighbors: correctly classified Treatment validation parents only
method.class_support_radius: 95th percentile train-parent distance to train class center

interpretation_limits: This is post-hoc validation attribution and cannot tune a new threshold or select a checkpoint.
Feature similarity cannot prove a label is wrong or that raw phenomenology is identical.
No test, OOF, full cascade, rejection, stable or P95 evaluation was executed.
